reviewDescription: I ordered these High Waisted - No See Through - Tummy Control Leggings in size X-XL in black. I was keen to see how these compared with a couple different brands of leggings sold on Amazon. These leggings seemed to be true to size. I’m 5 foot 8 inches tall, and the leggings fit based on my height and my weight which is approximately 155 - 160 lbs . It was easy to get into these leggings when sitting down. The length of the leggings was also a good match for my height. These leggings feel “buttery soft” as others have reported and there wasn’t an excess of material. The leggings also don’t feel too tight or restrictive anywhere. They seem to be good quality leggings but please keep in mind I haven’t washed them yet. The one area which really disappoints with these leggings is the advertised claim that these leggings provide “Tummy Control.” No, they do not. I have a medical issue which causes the bottom part of my stomach to “poof” - or to stick out - which I wish it didn’t because I’m self conscious about it. I was really hoping that these leggings would live up to their claim of having Tummy Control.” They absolutely didn’t. These legging are high waisted as advertised for those of us long legged ladies who need and look for this. The leggings in black are no see through as advertised. These leggings are also very soft as many people have appreciatively reported. I don’t presently know how these leggings will hold up to being placed in a zippered laundry bag, washed in a washing machine, and line dried vs hand washed in the sink and dried flat, at least initially,, before being transferred to drymg from the bottom part of a hanger. I would advise you to keep looking for different leggings if you really want and need the “tummy control” because there’s not even minimal “tummy control” with these leggings.
